text:
Eli Morgan: Kickoff for Kore Retail onboarding  target start Mon 2026-06-01. Need final stakeholder roster, owners for infra/enablement/data/billing, and clear 14-day success criteria. Any procurement/renewal flags? @Harper Diaz @Sofia Lin

Harper Diaz: I can lead enablement (45m). Will prepare agenda (console walkthrough, common errors, quick runbook). Tue mornings preferred by Product. Will post invite after agenda. :spiral_calendar:

Sofia Lin: I'll own infra set up and firewall coordination. Need network contact + approved IP ranges for Private option. CSM called out a procurement window ~42 days out ":warning:"  mark as medium renewal risk.

Devon Park: I'll do data ingestion and test prompt prep. Will upload a representative prompt set to shared drive and include mapping docs.

Eli Morgan: Draft 14-day success criteria: 1) staging end-to-end smoke with median gen latency <200ms; 2) 10 representative prompts meet quality gate (<=5% fail); 3) 3 engineers with console access and able to run tests; 4) billing estimate and quota sanity-check completed. Add model pin to rw-v1.3 and require PII handling signoff.

Harper Diaz: Sounds good. I'll include a 3-question feedback form for enablement.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Kore - Enablement" Wed 2026-06-02 17:00 UTC  https://calendar.example/evt/77777 :calendar:

Devon Park: Pre-onboard checklist (draft): - create service account + API key - provide IP allowlist entries - upload sample payloads/schema - grant console access to 3 engineers - share test prompt set in drive

Quick sanity curl for devs:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1.3","prompt":"<sanity test>","max_tokens":64}'
```

Sofia Lin: I'll own the 14-day health summary (p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, quality pass %, integration blockers, renewal signal). Draft by day 12.

Eli Morgan: Perfect. Cadence: enablement Wed, quick go/no-go Fri. I'll add the 42-day procurement review to the Renewal Signals sheet and add mitigation steps (exec intro + adoption highlights).
